headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 5, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels fell to the Baltimore Orioles in a 3-1 showdown, marking their final score in the matchup. Tyler O'Neill led the Orioles' offense with a home run, his eighth of the season. The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries and availability. The Los Angeles Angels' Sam Bachman has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right forearm radial nerve inflammation. The move is retroactive to August 3, 2026. The Athletics' Jeffrey Springs has also been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, due to right hip discomfort.

The Oakland Athletics have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson, acquired in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies. Johnson joins the Athletics in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have also made several trades, acquiring RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee in exchange for RHP Lake Bachar.
